offers.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 Gaming Laptop (16" 2.5K OLED Display / Intel Core Ultra 9 386H / 64GB RAM / 2TB SSD / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 / Windows 11 Home / GU606AX-DS98-CA)

reviews.quote: Its overall performance has also increased thanks to the Arrow Lake processor and the new GeForce RTX 5090 laptop GPU. However, it's still important to know that it uses a relatively slow version of the GPU. (NBC 'very good' 90% — tested this exact GPU/RAM/storage tier on the 2025 GU605CX; 2026 refresh changes the CPU only.)

professional.note: NBC's 90% anchor config (RTX 5090/64GB/2TB) maps directly to this tier, one CPU generation back; 2026 GU606AX pro review not retrieved 2026-11-24.

praises: The line as NBC tested it: 24GB 5090 + 64GB + 2TB in 1.88 kg — the most powerful ~1.9 kg gaming laptop money can buy
NBC: 'fantastic 240 Hz G-Sync OLED display', 'excellent speakers', 'brilliant input devices' — no compromises outside the GPU's power budget
24GB VRAM + 64GB RAM makes local LLM/AI work and heavy 4K video editing genuinely possible on the go
90Wh battery with ~9h lab WiFi runtime — flagship gaming laptop that can survive a meeting-heavy day
2x M.2 slots and Wi-Fi 7 round out a future-proof platform
complaints: NBC's headline con: the 5090 is 'unable to reach its potential' at the slim chassis's ~110W — you pay 5090 money for high-5080-class FPS
$7,699 exceeds most thicker 5090 laptops (Legion Pro 7i, Raider) by well over $1,000
Soldered RAM; 64GB ceiling fixed at purchase
OLED PWM flickering and low HDR peak brightness persist (NBC cons) at a price where brighter Mini-LED options exist
Lid creak, hinge rocking, and pulsating idle fans were NBC's remaining build/emissions gripes on this exact tier

design_philosophy: The flagship of ASUS's thin-first halo line — the config NBC itself reviewed (5090/64GB/2TB), now on the 2026 CPU refresh. It is the purest statement of the G16 idea: maximum silicon that a 1.88 kg aluminum OLED chassis can cool, sold to buyers who value portability and screen over peak FPS-per-dollar.
rating_notes: Closest entry to NBC's tested anchor (2025 GU605CX 5090/64GB/2TB, 90%): gaming 9.4 not 10 because NBC found the 5090 TGP-capped ('relatively slow version of the GPU'); -0.3 thermals_noise vs 5080 tier (NBC: constant fluctuating fans under load). +0.2 productivity / -0.2 battery for 386H 2026 refresh. Marked inferred because the 2026 GU606AX itself has no pro review retrieved.
